With a focus on a specific area of expertise, the incumbent will ensure that technical services in that area are provided to clients to meet both the current and future business needs, and that defined service levels for performance and availability are being met. Coordinate with other teams and/or external partners and service providers to ensure successful implementation of system software and/or hardware solutions, investigating issues/conflicts in test and in production and integrating changes as applicable across the group of companies. Coordinate and manage complex technical incident and problem resolution within various production and test environments by conducting research, investigation, and diagnosing and recommending solutions. Develop and establish operational processes and procedures to monitor and control various production and test environments. Provide technical leadership and consultation to internal customers and external partners on complex projects as the key representative of a given technology domain. Identify emerging technological trends and provide recommendations for technical strategy and direction to management. Provide training and mentoring to peers and clients as required, ensuring team members are aware of existing or new processes. Participate in change management processes to ensure clients are notified of system changes and that IT change procedures are followed for approving and implementing changes. To Join Our Team You have experience administrating and configuring Microsoft Azure Cloud. You have experience in a complex technical environment with understanding of operational process such as incident and change management including ITIL, and LEAN. You have experience creating and enhancing processes via automation of tasks while adhering to security controls. You leverage critical thinking skills to identify problems and proactively propose solutions. Your strong communication skills allow you to clearly convey messages. Training and development opportunities to grow your career. Flexible work options and paid time off to support your personal and family needs. A holistic approach to your well-being, with physical and mental health programs and a supportive workplace culture. Paid volunteer days to give back to your community. In addition to our competitive salary and incentive programs, eligible employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package including group retirement savings plans, pension and benefits (e.g., health and wellness, dental, disability and life coverage), mental health support and an employee assistance program. Être à l’affût des nouvelles tendances technologiques et formuler des recommandations à la haute direction quant à la stratégie et l’orientation à adopter. Offrir de la formation et de l’encadrement aux pairs et à la clientèle et s’assurer que les membres de l’équipe connaissent les processus existants ou nouvellement établis.
